targets.rawSql: SELECT date AS time, tool, SUM(lines_added) AS lines_added FROM daily_contributions WHERE $__timeFilter(date) GROUP BY date, tool ORDER BY date
SELECT date AS time, tool, COUNT(DISTINCT author) AS dau FROM daily_active_users WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND tool != 'human' GROUP BY date, tool ORDER BY date

SELECT d.date AS time, dau.tool, COUNT(DISTINCT dau.author) AS wau FROM generate_series((SELECT MIN(date) FROM daily_active_users), CURRENT_DATE, '1 day'::interval) AS d(date) JOIN daily_active_users dau ON dau.date BETWEEN d.date - INTERVAL '6 days' AND d.date WHERE $__timeFilter(d.date) AND dau.tool != 'human' GROUP BY d.date, dau.tool ORDER BY d.date

SELECT d.date AS time, dau.tool, COUNT(DISTINCT dau.author) AS mau FROM generate_series((SELECT MIN(date) FROM daily_active_users), CURRENT_DATE, '1 day'::interval) AS d(date) JOIN daily_active_users dau ON dau.date BETWEEN d.date - INTERVAL '29 days' AND d.date WHERE $__timeFilter(d.date) AND dau.tool != 'human' GROUP BY d.date, dau.tool ORDER BY d.date

SELECT cohort_date AS time, CASE WHEN origin IN ('claude', 'windsurf', 'ai', 'cursor') THEN 'AI' ELSE 'Human' END AS origin_group, AVG(survival_pct) AS avg_survival FROM code_halflife WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM code_halflife) GROUP BY cohort_date, origin_group ORDER BY cohort_date

SELECT cohort_date AS time, origin, AVG(survival_pct) AS avg_survival FROM code_halflife WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM code_halflife) AND origin IN ('claude', 'windsurf', 'cursor') GROUP BY cohort_date, origin ORDER BY cohort_date

list.name: repo
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT repo FROM daily_contributions ORDER BY repo
